headlines.title: Top adviser to Kennedy resigns from Trump administration
headlines.description: Means, a key advocate for the “Make America Healthy Again” movement, had grown frustrated with a lack of progress on his policy goals, a source familiar with his departure said.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: AI model uses facial photos to estimate cancer survival and biological age
headlines.description: Researchers at Mass General Brigham developed AI models trained on 40 million facial images that may predict cancer survival and estimate biological age — but they say the tools aren't ready for clinical use. NBC News artificial intelligence reporter Jared Perlo and NBC News medical contributor Dr. Akshay Syal explain how it works.

headlines.title: Remembering Dr. Rachna Shroff, Trailblazer in Cancer Research
headlines.description: Dr. Rachna Shroff, a leading physician-scientist who spent much of her career researching treatments for gastrointestinal cancers, has died at the age of 47. Reporting for TODAY, NBC’s Anne Thompson shares a look at the legacy Dr. Shroff cemented in her final days that will outlive her by helping others faced with the same disease.

headlines.title: Groundbreaking Trial Could Help You Live Longer and Healthier
headlines.description: Using cutting-edge AI and real-time data, researchers at Mount Sinai Hospital in New York City are launching an ambitious project that aims to fundamentally shift the way patients receive care, from treating sickness to predicting and preventing it. NBC’s Kate Snow reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Pope Leo Will Not Need Further Cancer Treatment, Vatican Says
headlines.description: The Vatican announced on Wednesday that Pope Leo XIV will not need further treatment following lung cancer surgery just one week ago. Tests confirmed that the cancer had not spread, and now the 71-year-old is moving forward with his plans to visit South America in November.

headlines.title: Every tool you need to bake a perfect batch of cookies, according to pastry chefs
headlines.description: Professional bakers break down everything you need to make homemade cookies, especially during the holidays. Here are their top tips for beginner to advanced bakers.

headlines.title: 23+ gifts the coffee lovers in your life will be buzzing about beyond the holidays
headlines.description: The best gifts to buy coffee lovers include beans, mugs, brewers and brewing accessories. Here are our top picks, hand-picked by coffee lovers themselves.

headlines.title: Tired of eczema flare-ups? Here are the lotions that actually help
headlines.description: If you’re looking for an eczema treatment, the right lotion can help you find some relief. Shop the best eczema lotions from CeraVe, Aveeno, Vanicream and more.

headlines.title: The ultimate gift guide for music lovers
headlines.description: Shop the best gifts for music lovers, from headphones and record players to instruments and stocking stuffers, with picks from NBC Selected editors.

headlines.title: Miley Cyrus Helps Fan Shave Her Head Before Chemo Treatment: ‘Let’s Go Girl’
headlines.description: Miley Cyrus recently stepped up to help a fan and fellow musician Cash Jacobs during an emotional battle with breast cancer.
